title: AI Value and Operator Signal Workbench
goal: Turn AI from a mostly passive/degraded panel into a clear operator workbench for signals, explanations, repair proposals, report help, and safe build-lane handoff.
scope: Unify AI provider status, ChatGPT OAuth session health, AI Signal Inbox, repair proposals, finding enrichment, report draft, and build-lane fix creation into a discoverable operator workbench. AI must explain runner failures and skipped states, propose safe actions, create build-lane tasks where code/config fixes are needed, and never mutate active runtime directly.
generation_reason: The operator reports that AI still has little practical value: ChatGPT OAuth appears disconnected or repeatedly requires login, repair proposals do not continue runs, and signals are hard to inspect or address. This task extends backlog-132 rather than duplicating it by making AI operationally useful across all AI entry points.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: AI may propose, explain, and create build-lane tasks. AI must not directly edit active runtime, dispatch scans, install tools, approve gates, or modify customer targets.

success_criteria: Operators can open one AI workbench/inbox and see all AI signals for the selected run and engagement.
ChatGPT OAuth status is stable, understandable, and includes a clear reconnect/refresh path.
AI repair output distinguishes retry, continue, accept-gap, and build-lane-fix actions with explicit eligibility.
AI can create a repo-backed task package for code/config/tool fixes without touching active runtime.
Disabled/provider-failure states are compact, high-contrast, and do not expose raw backend errors unless expanded.
Report draft, AutoFix, finding enrichment, and repair signals share a consistent status model.

required_checks: Focused API tests for AI signal/action contracts and ChatGPT OAuth reuse/degraded states
Focused browser tests for AI workbench, disabled provider, repair proposal, and build-lane task creation
acceptance_criteria: A failed safe fixture runner can produce an AI triage signal, show a concrete eligible action, and create a build-lane task without mutating active runtime.

before_promotion: backlog-151 has completed or been explicitly deferred by the operator.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
